subject.title: feat: session rail with read-only session companion in Control UI chat

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the three session-companion Gateway RPCs and make Control UI `/btw` and `/side` use the bounded session companion rather than the detached BTW path?
rationale: This is a new cross-client Gateway contract and a deliberate Control UI command-semantics change; tests and proof can validate implementation quality but cannot choose the long-term product and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve the session-companion contract
options.body: Keep the additive RPCs and Control UI rail after the main-chat event leak is fixed and the exact head completes required validation.

options.title: Narrow to a Control UI-local experiment
options.body: Avoid publishing the companion RPCs until maintainers settle a shared Android, TUI, and native-client contract.

options.title: Retain detached BTW behavior
options.body: Keep the existing Control UI BTW path and land only the independently useful prompt-cache-key fixes separately.

recommendation.title: Approve the session-companion contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive RPCs and Control UI rail after the main-chat event leak is fixed and the exact head completes required validation.
